strange.name: an oil seep
strange.rumor: A slow drip, unhurried, under the smell of good oil.
strange.text: Good lamp oil, weeping slowly from a seam in the ceiling glass.

strange.name: bad air
strange.rumor: The draft coming up tastes sweet, and should not.
strange.text: The lamp flame goes green a half-breath before your lungs notice.

strange.name: a kind stranger
strange.text: Another living soul down here, briefly, with clean bandages and no questions.

strange.name: a collapse
strange.rumor: Grit sifting down; the ceiling working through an old thought.
strange.text: The stratum shrugs in its sleep.

strange.name: whispering glass
strange.rumor: A murmuring of many small voices, none raised.
strange.text: A wall of panes, murmuring in a language you almost failed to not understand.

strange.name: a gift in reflection
strange.rumor: Lamplight coming back from below, a half-beat late.
strange.text: Your reflection arrives late, and it is carrying itself better than you are.

strange.name: a slipped hour
strange.rumor: Your own steps echoed back later than they should be.
strange.text: You check the lamp twice. Between the two checks, something took its share.

strange.name: old stairs
strange.rumor: A clean draft rising straight, as through a stairwell.
strange.text: A true stairway, cut by people who meant descent to be survivable.

strange.name: a delver's cache
strange.rumor: A frayed rope-end round a rock, tied by someone who knew knots.
strange.text: Somebody's carefully hidden haul. Somebody who stopped coming back for it.

strange.name: the murmur market
strange.rumor: Trade-cant, softly, from behind something hanging.
strange.text: Voices trading softly behind a curtain of hanging shards. A price is agreed before you speak.
